title: A vague 'eventually' aim: ZOH suggests a goal for the week built on what they shared, and day 1 is its first step
origin: Issue #165 (near-term goals: a goal for the week), walkthrough case 4

answers.what: build my own website, I did a bit of HTML in school

history.text: I do graphic design, so I'd want it to show my work
A designer with their own site, love that. Is there something you're working toward with it?

testerLines: not sure honestly, a full portfolio site eventually. I'd hand-code it, and weeknights work best
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake (#165).
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH helps Jordan land on a goal for the week built on what they shared (a designer, a bit of HTML, wants a portfolio site eventually): something exciting and reachable in about 3 to 7 steps, for example a one-page site with their name and a few pieces of work, live by Sunday, with a short reason, as a suggestion they can change, never pushed. It comes before or in the plan; the plan shows it as where they're headed, with day 1 fully defined as its first step (weeknights at 9 pm, 30 min, at the laptop) and proof that fits. Not a far-off goal (the full portfolio) and not something far too hard for a week. After 'yeah that sounds good' it asks for the commitment in natural words; after 'I'm in!' it locks.
